pages.title: Andy Asteroids?
pages.text: Andy Asteroids is the race that follows every level of Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994). Jim flies his rocket through a tunnel against Psy-Crow, dodging asteroids and collecting fuel pods. It was named after Andy Astor, one of the game's programmers, according to Sega Retro. VGMPF credits the music to Tony Bernetich.

pages.title: A banjo in space
pages.text: The Sega-16 review by Platonism (2005) praised "deliberately out-of-place tunes" in Earthworm Jim and gave as an example a "banjo song during a race in space".

pages.title: Programmed on the Super NES
pages.text: According to Wikipedia, programmer Nick Jones wrote the Andy Asteroids races for the Super NES first, and then converted them to the Genesis.
